units.source_text: 女人慌慌张张地捡起手巾，没料想，她竟狠命地往自己脸上掸了两三下，

en.t: The woman hurriedly picked up the towel, but unexpectedly she slapped it hard against her own face two or three times,

units.source_text: 然后，唰地别转身去，低下了头。

en.t: then abruptly turned away and lowered her head.
That must have been a gesture of embarrassment.
Even so, it was far too oblivious to the situation.

units.source_text: 男人大声叫嚷起来，话语像大坝决口似的冲出来：

en.t: The man began shouting loudly, his words bursting out like a dam giving way:
